messages:
sanjay: quick follow-up from today's postmortem. pattern = config drift + missing scoped flags. we need tighter blast-radius defaults + an auditable action tracker so items don't slip.
emma: Agree. Two immediate asks: (A) auto-mitigation flow (soft-shrink -> hard-kill) with timers, (B) postmortem tracker column for 'guardrails_active' + owner and due date.
ryan: For auto-mitigation, proposal: 90s window check, soft-shrink reduces sample by 60%, wait 3m, then full flag kill if no improvement. attach clear alerts and a one-click rollback link.
sanjay: owners: RYAN -> infra flow and playbook (due Tue EOD). EMMA -> tracker schema change + backfill last 20 incidents (due Thu). SANJAY -> update exec summary and add weekly audit calendar (due Mon).
emma: also add a rule: any flag created >5% must have a justification field and an approver. automated check on PR merge.
ryan: pseudocode I'll include in the spec:
```
if window(90s).error_rate > 0.04 or p99 > baseline + 150ms:
  reduce_sample_by(0.6) # soft-shrink
  wait(180s)
  if not recovered:
    trigger_flag_kill(flag_id)
  notify(#incidents)
```
deploy-bot: ticket created: TICK-4107 (assign with `/claim`).
sanjay: decision capture: soft-shrink -> hard-kill fallback, default max scope 1% global / 6% region, mandatory justification for >5% flags, new tracker column. owners + dates assigned.
emma: I'll run a short smoke in staging for the flag-kill path and report perf impact.
ryan: I'll include a test harness and a tiny sequence diagram in the PR. ETA Tue.
sanjay: let's reconvene async next Wednesday 10m check to confirm progress. thanks all.
